child_contingency_window_months.description: Payments reduced within this many months before or after a child reaches 18, 21 or the local age of majority are presumed associated with a child contingency.

multiple_reductions_window_years.description: For reductions on two or more occasions, the window, in years, before or after each child reaches a certain age.

multiple_reductions_min_age.description: Lower end of the range of ages (the certain age each child reaches) for payments reduced on two or more occasions.

multiple_reductions_max_age.description: Upper end of the range of ages (the certain age each child reaches) for payments reduced on two or more occasions.

alimony_recapture_threshold.description: Amount by which alimony payments must decrease in the third year for recapture to apply.
